title: Kaliningrad is the Achilles’ heel of Putin in the Baltic Sea
lede: With Kaliningrad’s residents now hearing air-raid sirens and Crimea’s lifelines under fire, Russian “trophy territories” risk turning into winter pressure cookers for both Moscow and the civilians trapped inside.
